description: 每项intent对应一个场景，先保存标题、详细摘要和SceneProgram再提交；真实场景策略启用时每项必须绑定完整SceneProgram和保存计划。

inputs.intents: array of name/description/split with optional layout/target_items and a required scene_program_path when realistic-scene policy is enabled

outputs.scene_ready: terminal state with tasks and artifact references
